title: First aorist active endings
subtitle: Read a completed action in the past indicative.
overview: First-aorist active indicative endings differ from present endings: -α, -ας, -ε(ν), -αμεν, -ατε, -αν.
Parse stem and ending separately: the aorist marker tells the form family; the ending tells person and number.

sections.title: ἔλυσα: active indicative
rows: I / you / he or she loosed

items.en: He or she proclaimed the gospel.
